borzoi.install: pip install -e <checkout of https://github.com/calico/borzoi at 5c9358222b5026abb733ed5fb84f3f6c77239b37>   (README.md:26-31; the image's route)
borzoi.note: the commit is the pin (git describe v1.0.0-7-g5c93582: seven commits after tag v1.0.0; origin/main's tip at the time of the clone). The borzoi_sad.py digest (stock_scripts below) is the one the kit's build.py (STOCK_SHA, STOCK_COMMIT) and the package's stock gate assert.

baskerville.install: pip install -e <checkout of https://github.com/calico/baskerville at 544073b87245d9f43ba63442c75bdbf32a9f8720>   (borzoi README.md:19-24; the image's route)
baskerville.role: the library: seqnn.SeqNN (model build / restore / ensemble), layers (EnsembleReverseComplement, SwitchReverse), dataset (targets_prep_strand, untransform_preds1), vcf (vcf_snps, snp_seq1), dna (dna_1hot)
baskerville.note: tag v1.0.0 == the commit == origin/main's tip at the time of the clone

archive_recipe: git archive --format=tar --prefix=<name>-<commit7>/ <commit> | gzip -n   (the whole tree at the commit, no .git; `git archive` regenerates the same bytes). An archive install needs a version for setuptools_scm (no .git inside): SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION_FOR_<BORZOI|BASKERVILLE>=<version> pip install --no-deps stock/<archive>.

entry_point.output: <out_dir>/sad.h5 (opened 'w': an existing file is overwritten; out_dir created non-recursively, borzoi_sad.py:155-156)
entry_point.stdout_stderr: SeqNN.verbose defaults True (seqnn.py:54): model.summary() and model_strides/target_lengths/target_crops print to stdout on every run (seqnn.py:209-210, 1232-1235); tqdm progress on stderr (borzoi_sad.py:260); vcf warnings on stderr (vcf.py:234-248)

library_defaults.one_hot: vcf.snp_seq1 -> vcf.dna_length_1hot -> dna.dna_1hot(seq, n_uniform=True): float16 (seq_len, 4), N = 0.25 in every channel (vcf.py:252-261, 495-514; dna.py:68-69, 85-86); window 1-based [pos-(seq_len//2-1), pos+seq_len//2] i.e. 0-based fetch(chr, pos-1-262143, pos+262144) for a SNV at seq_length 524288 (vcf.py:198-212); N-fill before the contig start and after its end (vcf.py:209-216)
library_defaults.batch: [ref, alt] one-hot list -> np.array (2, 524288, 4); train.batch_size == 2 -> one call seqnn_model(snps_1hot), ref = [0], alt = [1] (borzoi_sad.py:262-271); batch_size == 1 would run ref and alt separately (borzoi_sad.py:266-268)
library_defaults.rc: --rc -> SeqNN.build_ensemble(True, [0]) (seqnn.py:238-279): layers.EnsembleReverseComplement (gather [3,2,1,0] on the channel axis, reverse the length axis; layers.py:959-978) -> the base model on fwd and rc -> layers.SwitchReverse(strand_pair) reverses the rc prediction's length axis and gathers the strand_pair columns (layers.py:998-1034) -> tf.keras.layers.Average (seqnn.py:276). Per variant: 2 sequences x 2 orientations inside one ensemble call.
library_defaults.shifts: --shifts default '0' -> [0] -> shift_bool False -> no EnsembleShift (seqnn.py:240-248; layers.py:1090-1107)
library_defaults.slice: -t -> build_slice(targets_df.index): tf.gather on the last axis (seqnn.py:296-320); with targets_human.txt the index is 0..7610 (every column)
library_defaults.restore: seqnn.SeqNN(params_model) builds every head (seqnn.py:38-42, 132-213); restore(model_file) = models[0].load_weights (seqnn.py:1148-1154)
library_defaults.target_length: seq_length / model stride, cropped: 524288 / 32 = 16384 bins, minus Cropping1D 5120 on each side = 6144 (examples/params.json:18, 26-69; the value SeqNN prints as target_lengths, seqnn.py:1225-1234)
library_defaults.untransform: -u -> dataset.untransform_preds1 (dataset.py:406-434): preds / scale; where preds > clip_soft: clip_soft + (preds - clip_soft)**2; sum_stat containing '_sqrt': ** (4/3); then * scale (unscale=False). Default (no -u) -> dataset.untransform_preds (dataset.py:378-403): clip_soft - 1 + (preds - clip_soft + 1)**2 where preds > clip_soft; '_sqrt' columns -1 + (preds + 1)**2; no scale. --no_untransform skips both; no -t skips both (borzoi_sad.py:274-281). targets_df.scale / clip_soft are float64 arrays, so the float32 predictions promote to float64 from the first divide onward.
library_defaults.strand_collapse: targets_prep_strand (dataset.py:352-375) keeps every row whose identifier does not end in '-' (paired rows collapse to the '+' row); the script builds its own dok_matrix strand_transform (borzoi_sad.py:189-200; NOT dataset.make_strand_transform, dataset.py:314-349) and right-multiplies: preds (L x T) * (T x T') (borzoi_sad.py:284-286)
library_defaults.stats: write_snp_len (borzoi_sad.py:408-523): SAD = sum_L(alt) - sum_L(ref); logSAD = sum_L(log2(alt+1)) - sum_L(log2(ref+1)); D2 = sqrt(sum_L((alt-ref)^2)); logD2 = sqrt(sum_L((log2(alt+1)-log2(ref+1))^2)); each clipped to the float16 range and stored float16 (lines 436-439, 444-447, 474-478, 479-483)
library_defaults.sum_length_path: sum_length = (options.sad_stats == 'SAD') compares a list to a str (borzoi_sad.py:159, 210): always False -> build_sad()/write_snp are never reached; every run takes write_snp_len
library_defaults.percentiles: write_pct (borzoi_sad.py:372-395): 279 percentiles (0.001..0.099 step 0.001, 0.10..0.89 step 0.01, 0.900..0.999 step 0.001), float64; <stat>_pct = np.percentile(stat, 100*p, axis=0).T -> (num_targets, 279) float16
library_defaults.tf_numerics: no TF32 / mixed-precision call in borzoi_sad.py, seqnn.py or layers.py (grep tensor_float_32|mixed_precision|set_floatx: none in the SAD path; mixed_float16 appears only in hound_eval*.py / hound_train.py): the SAD route runs at TensorFlow's own defaults (float32 Keras policy; TF32 execution enabled by TensorFlow's default on Ampere+ GPUs — the image: tf.config.experimental.tensor_float_32_execution_enabled() == True)
library_defaults.training_time_params_inert_at_inference: model.augment_rc / augment_shift (examples/params.json:19-20) build StochasticReverseComplement / StochasticShift layers that return the input unchanged when training is not True (layers.py:987-995, 1128-1141) and a SwitchReverse with a constant False (seqnn.py:141-144, 185-191)

datasets.ref_allele: S (flipped only when vcf_snps(flip_ref=True) — never in borzoi_sad.py; lines 337-351)
